outcome: Give government cio / agency operations director a governed method to improve energy use per occupied square metre using building telemetry, occupancy and maintenance logs, with final decisions…
overview: Public Asset Occupancy and Energy Efficiency addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in government and public sector operations. The first proof of value uses building telemetry, occupancy and maintenance logs. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is energy use per occupied square metre, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: energy use per occupied square metre

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: building telemetry, occupancy and maintenance logs; define energy use per occupied square metre and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Government CIO / Agency Operations Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
